## Problem

What problem should SEIS solve?

## Proposed Capability

Describe the feature, platform lane, agent workflow, MCP surface, design system
primitive, data capability, or governance improvement.

## Architecture Fit

Why does this belong in SEIS long term?

## Users

Who benefits from this: developers, designers, AI researchers, educators,
maintainers, or another group?

## Maintenance Cost

Does this require a new dependency, SDK, runtime, service, or CI tool?

## Alternatives

What simpler or lower-risk options should be considered?
